## Parental OpControl 0.17.5

- Follow-up to 0.17.4, which shipped the lock-screen font fix. The lock text now uses the bundled Fredoka/Nunito faces as intended, but the older helper controls (lock messages panel, tray menu) were also pointed at those private faces; GDI cannot see a private font and fell back to Microsoft Sans Serif instead of the 0.17.3 Segoe UI weights.
- The legacy helper font accessors are restored to their exact 0.17.3 system fonts, so only the lock overlay changes. No data, account, PIN, family or Windows setting changes; Luna stays enabled with the same key.
- This release is installed on the X1 only; the Yoga is not updated.
